<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    const selectBox = document.querySelector('[id^="nom_etablissement"]');
    
    // Hide section1 initially
    const section1 = document.getElementById('section1');
    const storedValue = sessionStorage.getItem('selectedValue');  // Retrieve stored selected value
    const dataStored = document.getElementById('data_stored').value;
    
    // Function to show the fields based on selected value
    function showFields(selectedValue) {
        // Parse the data stored in hidden input
        const res = JSON.parse(dataStored);
        let found = false;

        res.forEach((r) => {
            if (r['id'] === selectedValue) {
                // Show the section
                section1.style.display = "block";
                console.log(r);  // Log for debugging

                // Set values for the input fields
                document.getElementById('site_web').value = r['c_site_web'] || '';
                document.getElementById('numero_fax').value = r['c_numero_fax'] || '';
                document.getElementById('numero_tel').value = r['c_numero_tel'] || '';
                document.getElementById('adresse_electronique').value = r['c_adresse_electronique'] || '';
                document.getElementById('adresse_etablissement').value = r['c_adresse_etablissement'] || '';
                document.getElementById('date_obtention_agrement').value = r['c_date_obtention_agrement'] || '';
                document.getElementById('abreviation_agrement').value = r['c_abreviation_agrement'] || '';

                // Set all fields to read-only
                setFieldsReadOnly();
                found = true; // Mark as found
            }
        });

        // If no matching value was found, hide the section and reset values
        if (!found) {
            hideFields();
        }
    }

    // Function to set fields to read-only
    function setFieldsReadOnly() {
        document.getElementById('site_web').readOnly = true;
        document.getElementById('numero_fax').readOnly = true;
        document.getElementById('numero_tel').readOnly = true;
        document.getElementById('adresse_electronique').readOnly = true;
        document.getElementById('adresse_etablissement').readOnly = true;
        document.getElementById('date_obtention_agrement').readOnly = true;
        document.getElementById('abreviation_agrement').readOnly = true;
    }

    // Function to remove read-only (in case of editing)
    function removeFieldsReadOnly() {
        document.getElementById('site_web').readOnly = false;
        document.getElementById('numero_fax').readOnly = false;
        document.getElementById('numero_tel').readOnly = false;
        document.getElementById('adresse_electronique').readOnly = false;
        document.getElementById('adresse_etablissement').readOnly = false;
        document.getElementById('date_obtention_agrement').readOnly = false;
        document.getElementById('abreviation_agrement').readOnly = false;
    }

    // Function to hide fields
    function hideFields() {
        section1.style.display = "none";
        resetFields();  // Reset fields when hiding section
    }

    // Function to reset all fields
    function resetFields() {
        document.getElementById('site_web').value = '';
        document.getElementById('numero_fax').value = '';
        document.getElementById('numero_tel').value = '';
        document.getElementById('adresse_electronique').value = '';
        document.getElementById('adresse_etablissement').value = '';
        document.getElementById('date_obtention_agrement').value = '';
        document.getElementById('abreviation_agrement').value = '';
    }

    // Handle the select box change
    function handleTypeChange() {
        const selectedValue = selectBox.value;
        sessionStorage.setItem('selectedValue', selectedValue);  // Save the selected value
        if (selectedValue) {
            showFields(selectedValue);
        } else {
            hideFields();  // Hide fields if no value is selected
        }
    }

    // Trigger change event when selectBox changes
    selectBox.addEventListener("change", handleTypeChange);

    // On page load, check if there's a stored value and show appropriate fields
    if (storedValue) {
        selectBox.value = storedValue;  // Set the select box value
        showFields(storedValue);  // Show corresponding fields based on stored value
    } else {
        hideFields();  // Ensure section is hidden if no value
    }

    // Ensure fields are shown and read-only after form submission (even with validation errors)
    document.querySelector('form').addEventListener('submit', function() {
        const selectedValue = selectBox.value;
        if (selectedValue) {
            showFields(selectedValue);
        } else {
            hideFields();
        }
        setFieldsReadOnly();  // Ensure they are read-only after validation
    });

});
</script>
